'''Benta-Lo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was injured while fighting at the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] and asked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] to dispose the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] of their weapons.<ref name="TOR" />
